facts.business: The company is engaged in trading of industrial chemicals, investments, and leasing activities.
key_risks: Near-term volatility impacting cost structures across energy intensive industries including chemicals
Variable macro factors influencing global demand and supply
facts.related_party_note: The Company has entered into transaction(s) with an entity belonging to the promoter/promoter group who hold 10% or more shareholding in the Company. The Company granted an unsecured loan/inter-corporate deposit to Hardcastle Petrofer Private Limited, a related party. Aggregate loan amount during the year was Rs 671.00 lakhs with nil outstanding as on 31.3.2026.
